public.deletion.title: Delete my Djaber account
public.deletion.intro: You can request the deletion of your account and personal data without opening the app (Google Play / App Store requirement). The request is confirmed by e-mail, then a 30-day grace period applies during which you can cancel it by signing in again.
public.deletion.step1.title: Enter your account e-mail
public.deletion.step1.sub: we send a confirmation link valid for 24 h
public.deletion.step2.title: Confirm from the e-mail
public.deletion.step2.sub: your account is deactivated immediately; a data export is offered (JSON + CSV)
public.deletion.step3.title: 30-day grace period
public.deletion.step3.sub: sign in again to cancel; otherwise your personal data is permanently anonymised
public.deletion.owner.title: Owner of an active shop?
public.deletion.owner.sub: first transfer the ownership or delete the shop from Settings › Danger zone
public.deletion.form.consent: I understand that the conversations, orders and products linked to my account will be anonymised; invoices are kept for 10 years without personal data (legal obligation).
public.deletion.sent.title: Check your inbox
public.deletion.sent.text: If an account exists for {email}, an e-mail has been sent with a confirmation link valid for 24 h.
public.deletion.partial.sub: export, removing a Meta page…: support takes care of it.

public.deletion.confirm.text: Account {email} · requested on {date} · link valid until {expires}.
public.deletion.confirm.export: Export my data (JSON + CSV) — download link valid for 7 days

public.deletion.grace.login: You can also cancel by signing in again.
